title: High-Dimension Human Value Representation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating value-eliciting questions based on established sociological value frameworks (e.g., World Value Survey, Hofstede's cultural dimensions, Schwartz theory) across 25 languages, extracting high-dimensional value embeddings using a Siamese network (UniVaR), and analyzing the distances and clustering of these representations to assess how LLMs prioritize distinct cultural values.

Evaluating whether the learned value representations inadvertently capture linguistic artifacts or translationese by testing source language identification and model distinguishability using non-value-eliciting questions and a parallel multilingual corpus (EuroParl).
